value.message: Town of Oakville runs Preschool Levels A-E swim lessons, YMCA of Oakville has 3-5 year old lessons at Peter Gilgan Family YMCA, and Goldfish Swim School does ages 4 months-12 years at $32.50 a lesson - their sites say; I could not get into their pages today for days or times. I'll keep watching and text you when I find them.
